title: LibScript Empirical Experiment Suite Manifest
description: Declarative specification for reproducible, multi-ISA empirical benchmark suites, SIGPLAN statistical policies, provenance envelopes, lockfiles, prerequisite gates, and LaTeX macro emission.

id.description: Unique lowercase identifier for the experiment suite (e.g., libtpu, edgcpp, win_port, libscript).

title.description: Human-readable title describing the empirical evaluation campaign.

protocol_version.description: Semantic version or conference protocol tag for the evaluation specification.

manuscript_dir.description: Relative or absolute path to the manuscript directory containing the target LaTeX source.

manuscript_tex.description: Primary LaTeX manuscript filename relative to manuscript_dir (e.g., libtpu_paper.tex or win_port_paper.tex).

manuscript_files.description: List of LaTeX manuscript files (e.g., main paper and appendix) verified for zero unresolved placeholders, page budgets, and double-blind hygiene.

items.description: Verification policy for an individual LaTeX manuscript target.

tex_path.description: Filename or path of the LaTeX document relative to manuscript_dir.

expected_tbd_count.description: Number of sanitized \tbd{???} placeholder sites governed in this LaTeX file.

max_pages.description: Optional maximum compiled PDF page budget enforced when PDF compilation is enabled.

check_double_blind.description: Whether compiled PDF metadata and text streams are audited against double-blind author or path leaks.

target_repo_dir.description: Relative or absolute path to the primary subject source repository under empirical evaluation.

ecosystem_repos.description: Multi-repository inventory for ecosystem-scale evaluations (e.g., 14 win_port repositories plus upstream source trees).

items.description: Metadata and exclusion policy for a single evaluated repository.

id.description: Short canonical repository identifier (e.g., cdd-c, auto-win-msvc, msi-rs, win-cmd-rs).

path.description: Relative or absolute filesystem path to the repository checkout.

language.description: Primary implementation language used to select LoC and disaggregated coverage tools (e.g., c89, rust, python, ruby).

exclude_globs.description: Generated or cached directory globs excluded from hand-written LoC accounting (e.g., rewritten_src).

items.description: Directory or glob pattern excluded from hand-written source counts.

role.description: Architectural role in the evaluation (e.g., core_compiler, compat_layer, packager, linter, port_harness, vm_substrate, upstream_ref).

lockfiles.description: Pinned provenance lockfiles recording exact upstream git commit SHAs, release tags, and SHA-256 artifact digests.

items.description: Specification of a single provenance lockfile verified prior to benchmark sweeps.

id.description: Unique identifier for the lockfile (e.g., c_upstreams, batch_wild_corpus).

path.description: Relative path to the JSON lockfile.

kind.description: Lockfile schema category determining SHA-256 archive and git commit verification rules.

required_entries.description: Minimum number of pinned upstream entries or repositories required in the lockfile.

results_dir.description: Output directory where mechanical JSON benchmark artifacts are emitted.

generated_tex_path.description: Output path for generated single-source LaTeX metric macros and tables.

execution_modes.description: Supported host execution and unconfounded emulation or virtualization baseline modes across the campaign.

items.description: Named execution or baseline isolation mode.

host_constraints.description: Host ISA, binary translation prohibition, and OS preparation constraints (RULE-2, RULE-3).

required_native_isas.description: List of native OS/ISA targets required across the evaluation campaign (e.g., macos_arm64, linux_x64, windows_x64, freebsd_x64, freebsd_arm64, illumos_x64, dos32_le).

forbid_binary_translation.description: Whether native benchmark cells fail hard under Rosetta 2, QEMU user/TCG, binfmt_misc, or WoW64 emulation.

prepare_host.description: Whether CPU performance governor locking, ASLR disablement, and swapoff are requested when privileged.

require_ac_power.description: Whether benchmark host preparation verifies AC mains power status to prevent battery thermal throttling.

serialize_single_tu.description: Whether parallel build jobs are pinned to -j1 during single-TU compilation latency and peak RSS measurements.

drop_caches_on_cold.description: Whether cold subprocess measurements drop kernel page caches (or use cold binary copy / wineserver -k reset).

cloud_sku_by_arch.description: Recommended bare-metal, dedicated-core, or Vagrant guest SKUs keyed by OS/ISA target.

^[a-z0-9_-]+$.description: Cloud instance SKU or Vagrant box identifier for the target architecture.

trial_policy.description: Non-parametric and matched-optimization trial, warmup, quantile, timeout, and PRNG seed policy (RULE-3, RULE-4).

warmup_runs.description: Number of unrecorded warmup runs executed prior to timed trials (e.g., 1 untimed warmup for N=11 compiler latency runs).

measured_trials.description: Number of recorded fresh trials captured into samples_ns (e.g., 11 timed iterations per compiler pipeline cell).

quantiles.description: Non-parametric quantiles reported alongside min and max (e.g., [0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.99]).

items.description: Quantile fraction in the closed interval [0.0, 1.0].

dispersion_metric.description: Primary dispersion estimator used for tables and PGFPlots error bars (e.g., median_and_stddev for 1 warmup + N=11 median +/- sigma).

serialize_single_tu.description: Whether single-TU timed iterations force -j1 single-process execution to eliminate cache and memory-bus contention.

timeout_ms.description: Optional hard per-invocation subprocess deadline in milliseconds enforced via process group or Win32 Job Object termination.

prng_seed.description: Deterministic PRNG seed shared across reference, fuzzing, sampling, and target workload runs.

build_profile.description: Pinned cross-compiler optimization, CRT linking, validation parity, and stripping configuration (RULE-6).

cargo_profile_flags.description: Pinned Cargo release environment variables (opt-level, lto, codegen-units).

^[A-Z0-9_]+$.description: Pinned Cargo profile environment variable value.

cargo_forbid_unsafe.description: Whether Rust subject crates must enforce #![forbid(unsafe_code)] statically.

workspace_bins.description: Expected release binary names built across the Rust or C workspace.

c_compiler_flags.description: Pinned C11 benchmark harness compiler flags (e.g., ['-std=c11', '-O3']).

c89_strict_flags.description: Strict ISO C89/C90 pedantic syntax and prologue-declaration verification flags.

posix_opt_flags.description: Matched GCC/Clang optimization flags for POSIX or Cygwin baselines (e.g., ['-O3', '-DNDEBUG']).

msvc_flags.description: Matched MSVC cl.exe release and warning flags (e.g., ['/O2', '/DNDEBUG', '/W4']).

msvc_crt_variants.description: MSVC C Runtime linkage modes measured separately (e.g., ['MT', 'MD']).

items.description: MSVC static (MT) or dynamic (MD) CRT linkage identifier.

openwatcom_dos32_flags.description: Pinned OpenWatcom v2 wcl386 flags for 32-bit DOS LE protected-mode targets (e.g., ['-bt=dos', '-mf', '-3r', '-ox']).

msi_validation_modes.description: MSI validation parity modes separating CFB/CAB synthesis from 105-ICE SQL evaluation.

strip_mode.description: Deterministic post-link symbol stripping policy applied after recording unstripped sizes.

feature_variants.description: Named Cargo or CMake feature configurations built and measured (e.g., full vs. slim).

compiler_pipelines.description: Declarative single-stage and two-stage compiler pipeline specifications (e.g., EDG-FE-ONLY, EDG-LLVM, EDG-GCC, EDG-C-LEGACY, EDG-CPP-LEGACY, NATIVE-CLANG, NATIVE-GCC).

items.description: Single evaluated or baseline compiler pipeline configuration.

id.description: Canonical pipeline identifier (e.g., EDG-LLVM, EDG-GCC, EDG-C-LEGACY, NATIVE-CLANG).

manuscript_label.description: Human-readable pipeline label rendered in LaTeX tables and figures.

backend_mode.description: Code generation backend family invoked by this pipeline.

stages.description: Number of compilation stages (1 for direct IR/object backends; 2 for legacy .int.c or .int.cpp lowering).

dialect_flags.description: Front-end dialect and GNU compatibility flags (e.g., ['--gnu_version=130200']).

matched_baseline_id.description: Reference native compiler pipeline ID sharing the exact same LLVM or GCC/libgccjit optimizer version.

runtime_libs.description: Additional runtime archives linked for C++ EH or coroutine support (e.g., ['libedg.a']).

items.description: Runtime library filename or linker flag.

required_env_vars.description: Environment variables required by this pipeline (e.g., ['EDG_LIBGCCJIT_PATH', 'SDKROOT']).

integrity_guards.description: Non-negotiable experimental integrity invariants enforced across all benchmark sub-suites.

enforce_matched_opt_flags.description: Forbids cross-optimization-level ratio comparisons (requires -O0 vs -O0, -O2 vs -O2, -O3 vs -O3, -O2 -g vs -O2 -g).

require_same_llvm_baseline.description: Requires CLANG_MATCHED to match the exact LLVM version linked into cpfe.

require_same_gcc_libgccjit_baseline.description: Requires GCC_MATCHED and GXX_MATCHED to match the exact GCC version providing EDG_LIBGCCJIT_PATH.

separate_two_stage_legacy_accounting.description: Requires Stage 1, intermediate .int.c/.int.cpp byte size, and Stage 2 to be logged separately with total = Stage1 + Stage2 and RSS = max(Stage1, Stage2).

require_anti_dce_checksum.description: Requires microbenchmarks to feed runtime inputs through compiler memory barriers and verify output checksums.

corpus_inputs.description: SHA-256-pinned single-TU benchmark inputs and multi-TU open-source release tarballs with deterministic LoC accounting.

items.description: Single pinned benchmark input or upstream project corpus entry.

id.description: Unique workload or project identifier (e.g., sqlite3, lua, lz4, zlib, dash, jq, fmt, catch2, linux_5_15, linux_6_6).

url.description: Canonical upstream release archive download URL.

sha256.description: Expected 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the upstream archive.

libscript_component.description: Reusable Tier 1 component in _lib/ responsible for staging or building this input.

loc_mode.description: Line-of-code counting methodology reported in manuscript tables.

prereq_checks.description: Codebase prerequisite predicates that gate final benchmark locking (RULE-7).

items.description: Single prerequisite check gating one or more sub-suites.

id.description: Unique identifier for the prerequisite gate.

repo_id.description: Optional repository identifier in ecosystem_repos against which target is resolved.

suites.description: Sub-suite identifiers gated by this check (e.g., ['E1', 'E4']).

kind.description: Verification predicate type evaluated against the target repository.

target.description: Relative file path, build directory, or command inspected by the prerequisite gate.

pattern.description: Extended regular expression pattern matched for grep_present or grep_absent predicates.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what codebase milestone this gate verifies.

placeholder_registry.description: Deterministic mapping between sanitized manuscript placeholder counts (e.g., tbd or ???) and backing raw JSON/CSV artifacts.

total_placeholders.description: Total number of empirical placeholder slots across all manuscript_files (e.g., 60 or 285).

placeholder_patterns.description: Extended regular expressions identifying unresolved placeholders that must be absent from final LaTeX sources (e.g., ['\\\\tbd', '\\?\\?\\?']).

items.description: Single manuscript section or table entry in the placeholder registry.

id.description: Section or table label (e.g., abstract, tab:compile_perf, fig:sqlite_results, tab:corpus_matrix).

tex_file.description: Target LaTeX filename containing these placeholders.

line_range.description: Optional manuscript line number or span reference (e.g., 'll. 681-718').

count.description: Exact placeholder count populated in this section or table.

backing_artifacts.description: Raw JSON or CSV artifacts in results_dir supplying these metrics.

metrics.description: Optional list of JSON field paths populated into this manuscript location.

items.description: Metric key or JSON path extracted from backing_artifacts.

subsuites.description: Ordered DAG of empirical evaluation sub-suites (e.g., E0 through E8).

items.description: Declarative definition of a single empirical sub-suite.

id.description: Short sub-suite identifier (e.g., E0, E1, E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7, E8).

title.description: Descriptive title of the sub-suite and manuscript targets.

depends_on_suites.description: Upstream sub-suite IDs that must complete before this sub-suite runs.

libscript_deps.description: Reusable Tier 1 LibScript components required by this sub-suite.

entrypoint.description: Relative POSIX/Batch script stem invoked to execute the sub-suite.

require_native_isa.description: Whether this sub-suite enforces native non-translated ISA execution on primary cells (RULE-2).

trial_policy.description: Optional sub-suite-specific warmup, trial count, dispersion, seed, or timeout override.

warmup_runs.description: Sub-suite override for unrecorded warmup iterations.

measured_trials.description: Sub-suite override for recorded timed iterations.

dispersion_metric.description: Sub-suite override for statistical dispersion estimator.

timeout_ms.description: Sub-suite override for hard per-invocation subprocess timeout in milliseconds.

prng_seed.description: Sub-suite override for deterministic PRNG seed.

emulation_baselines.description: Optional controlled emulation or virtualization baselines evaluated alongside native cells in this sub-suite.

outputs.description: Expected JSON, CSV, or LaTeX output artifact paths relative to results_dir.
